City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 19, 2019 -
5:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the May 15, 2019 Special Joint Meeting and the May 15, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-06-19 SDWD Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2019-06-19 SDWD Item 08B Warrants
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Introduction and Adoption of FY 2019-20 and FY 2020-21 San Dieguito Water District Operating and Capital Budget. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
The Board adopt Resolution No. 2019-08 entitled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District, Adopting the Fiscal Year 2019-20 San Dieguito Water District Operating and Capital Budget."
2019-06-19 SDWD Item 10A Budget Report FY19-20 and FY20-21 Budget Adoption
10B.
Adoption of Resolution No. 2019-09 authorizing the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the San Dieguito Water District and Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Local 221; adopt Resolution No. 2019-10 approving salary and benefit changes for unrepresented employees and adopt Resolution No. 2019-11 approving position title and pay ranges and adopt Resolution No. 2019-12 amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 and Fiscal Year 2020-21 Operating Budget to include the costs of the changes. Contact Person: Director of Human Resources Bokosky
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-09 authorizing the City Manager or designee(s) to execute a Memorandum of Understanding between the San Dieguito Water District and Service Employees International Union Local 221; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-10, approving salary and benefit changes for unrepresented employees; 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-11, approving the Fiscal Year 2019-20 and Fiscal Year 2020-21 Position Title and Pay Range Schedule for all San Dieguito Water District employees; and 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-12 amending the adopted Fiscal Year 2019-20 and Fiscal Year 2020-21 operating budget to include the approved changes.
2019-06-19 SDWD Item 10B Approval of SEIU MOU
10C.
Advanced Metering Infrastructure Pilot Program. Contact Person: Operations Superintendent Aurora
Authorize the General Manager to purchase software and equipment from National Meter and Automation, in an amount not to exceed $100,462, for the implementation of an Advanced Metering Infrastructure Pilot Program.
2019-06-19 SDWD Item 10C Advanced Metering Infrastructure
10D.
Public Hearing Regarding San Dieguito Water District’s 2019 Public Health Goals Report. Contact Person: General Manager O’Donnell
The District Board receive public comments regarding San Dieguito Water District’s 2019 Public Health Goals Report, review and discuss the information presented, advise staff of any changes desired by the Board, and accept the report.
2019-06-19 SDWD Item 10D Public Hearing Regarding Public Health Goals
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
14A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON AUGUST 21, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
